stops.note: rest, repose, giving rise to quietus (at rest, free)
carried into French for setting someone free from an obligation, from quietus
stops.meaning: to set someone free from an obligation

stops.note: settled as the English word for stopping an action or leaving a job or place
stops.meaning: to stop doing something, or to leave a job or place

current_meaning: to stop doing something, or to leave a job, place, or activity
